{{Quote|Senator Meena Tills is believed to be among six hostages seized by an armed gang at Galactic City spaceport. Police have sealed off the area and all city traffic and interplanetary flights are being diverted. Expect long delays. More later.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] Update|<ref name="Target" />}}
The '''Traffic Division''' was the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] traffic [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] unit charged with monitoring the [[Skylane/Legends|skylanes]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Police officer/Legends|Patrol officers]] enforced speed limits and other traffic laws using [[RapidResponse police speeder/Legends|police speeders]]<ref name="core" /> and [[Coruscant Security Force assault ship|assault ships]].<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref> They were armed only with an [[Coruscant Security Force issue blaster|issue blaster]] but could contact [[Coruscant Security Force Dispatch|Dispatch]] and summon a [[police cruiser backup unit]] if need be. [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ia]] was a notable member of the division and enforced traffic regulations with a no-nonsense attitude.<ref name="core" />

At one point, skylane traffic around the [[Galactic City Spaceport]] was diverted by police due to an ongoing [[Galactic City spaceport hostage siege|hostage situation]] by [[Korun/Legends|Korunnai]] terrorists angry at the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Target">{{InsiderCite|81|Omega Squad: Targets}}</ref> Later, the Traffic Division assisted the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Guard|Guard]] with a [[Raid on Jabi Town|raid]] in the Coruscant [[Jabi Town]] district against [[Corellian/Legends|Corellians]] sympathetic to [[Corellia/Legends|their]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld's]] demand for independence. Later, it helped block traffic lanes during police actions against Corellian and [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] who were [[Coruscant terrorist attacks and riots|rioting]].<ref name="Bloodlines" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Traffic Divison first appeared as part of the biography of Lieutenant Ia in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] on [[January 3]], [[2003]]. It further appeared in ''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]'' written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published on [[August 29]], [[2006]].
